FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO — all people, addresses and events below are invented.

I am Robin Senn. My spouse Sami Senn and I live together at Illustration Lane 8, apartment 4, Bern. This is our family home. A registered item delivered to me on 2 October 2026 contained the landlord's tenancy-termination notice, with a proposed end date of 31 March 2027. We dispute the termination and want the available evidence assessed.

I attach our complete tenancy agreement and the original delivery record for the item addressed to me. The receipt proves what that delivery service recorded; it does not reproduce the notice or establish its legal validity. We do not have a scan of the notice yet. I cannot confirm whether Sami was served separately, and no separate spouse notice is supplied.

We report no rent arrears and no earlier complaint about tenancy rights. We have not decided whether to seek an extension; hardship and extension grounds remain unassessed. No challenge has been filed, no settlement reached and no response sent on our behalf.

FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO DOCUMENT
All persons, addresses, signatures, amounts and events are invented. This is the complete original text of this synthetic document.

RESIDENTIAL TENANCY AGREEMENT — IL-2023-008
Signed on 12 June 2023.

Landlord: Illustration Lane Properties SA, Fiction Square 3, 3000 Bern, Switzerland (fictional address).
Tenants: Robin Senn and Sami Senn, joint tenants and married spouses.
Property: Illustration Lane 8, apartment 4, 3000 Bern, Switzerland (fictional address); a three-room residential apartment with cellar C4.
Occupancy: Robin Senn and Sami Senn reside together in this apartment as their family home.

The tenancy starts on 1 July 2023 and continues for an indefinite term. The premises are for the tenants' ordinary residential use. The agreed net monthly rent is CHF 1,820 and the monthly advance for ancillary costs is CHF 210. Payment is due on the first day of each month. The agreed deposit is CHF 3,640.

The contractual notice period is three months to 31 March, 30 June, 30 September or 31 December. A notice must identify the tenancy and intended termination date. These are the parties' recorded contractual terms; this agreement does not establish the validity or service of any later notice.

There are no omitted schedules or later amendments in this fictional agreement.
Landlord signature: Elin Vale, authorized representative of Illustration Lane Properties SA (fictional signature).
Tenant signatures: Robin Senn and Sami Senn (fictional signatures).

FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO DOCUMENT
All persons, addresses, signatures and events are invented. This is the complete original delivery record in this synthetic case.

EXAMPLE PARCEL SERVICE — SIGNED DELIVERY RECORD
Record: EPS-DEMO-20261002-204
Service: registered letter with recipient signature.
Sender: Illustration Lane Properties SA, Fiction Square 3, 3000 Bern (fictional address).
Named addressee: Robin Senn.
Delivery address: Illustration Lane 8, apartment 4, 3000 Bern (fictional address).

The item was handed directly to Robin Senn at the delivery address on 2 October 2026 at 10:14 local time. Recipient identity was checked against the addressee name on the registered item. Robin Senn signed the delivery device upon receipt.
Recipient signature record: Robin Senn — received in person at 10:14 on 2 October 2026 (fictional signature).
Delivery agent: Neri Falk; route DEMO-BE-04 (fictional operator).
Service status: delivered; no failed delivery or proxy recipient is recorded.

Sender-declared item description: tenancy termination, reference IL-2023-008. The carrier did not open or authenticate the envelope contents. This record establishes only the named recipient, delivery method and recorded delivery date. It contains no delivery entry for Sami Senn and makes no statement about a separate item.
Record issued by Example Parcel Service on 2 October 2026 at 10:16 local time.
